caseName: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Corp. v. State Oil & Gas Board
caseNameFull: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Corp. v. State Oil and Gas Board of Mississippi

opinions.text: 474 U. S. 409. Motion of Louisiana for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in support of petitions for rehearing denied. Petitions of State Oil and Gas Board of Mississippi, Coastal Exploration, Inc., and Getty Oil Co. for rehearing denied.
